scripts.title: Auto Farm, Unit Ranking & Infinity Castle | Free, No Key
scripts.features:
Full auto farm for Beat the Anime Boss. Turn AUTO on and the script plays the whole loop by itself: it rolls a boss, attacks it, collects the money, and rerolls any boss that is too tough to kill so the farm never gets stuck.

WHAT IT DOES
- Auto farm: roll a boss, attack it, collect the money, reroll a wall
- Ranks every unit by its REAL damage and income - base stats x mutation x level - instead of by rarity or by level alone, so a fresh Epic beats a levelled Rare
- Fills every slot with the best units you own and keeps swapping the weakest one out. Units come before everything else
- Chest control: a full chest blocks every new drop, so the chest is kept clear and only what could not earn a slot is sold
- Buys upgrades in value order - unit slots, luck, summoner, roll speed
- Levels the units that return the most per dollar
- Walks the Infinity Castle by itself for potions, mutation crystals and awakening gems, and drinks the potions it finds
- Claims offline, daily, time and quest rewards, and redeems the codes

MOBILE
PC and mobile both. The panel asks which one on first run and scales itself to fit. German, English and Russian, and every setting survives a rejoin.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open Beat the Anime Boss
2. Paste the script below into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux - no gamepass and no limited product.

Open source, read it before you run it:
https://github.com/seltonmt012/sel01-rbx/blob/main/games/animeboss.lua

Discord: https://discord.gg/ARdpzFuKMm

scripts.title: ANTI CRASH/CLONE BY MEY
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local function sendChatMessage(text)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels")
        local general = channels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral")

        general:SendAsync(text)
    end)

    if not ok then
        warn("Failed to send chat message:", err)
    end
end

local function isClone(obj)
    local name = obj.Name:lower()

    return name == "clone"
        or name == "clonecharacter"
        or name:find("clone", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function removeClone(obj)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then
        return
    end

    if isClone(obj) then
        pcall(function()
            obj:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    removeClone(obj)
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    removeClone(obj)
end)
